newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela oil unions plan 8-hour stoppage Friday.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela oil unions plan 8-hour stoppage Friday.

text.p: Venezuela's oil workers' unions, Fedepetrol and Fedrahicarburos, are planning a national eight-hour stoppage on Friday in protest at working conditions, which could lead to wider action if workers' concerns are not addressed, said Fedepetrol chief Carlos Ortega.
He said the stoppage could affect oil production, but PDVSA denied this, saying if the stoppage went ahead, production would be maintained by teams of professional workers.
"Generally these stoppages are called off before they happen," a PDVSA spokeswoman said.
Ortega said workers' complaints included profit-related pay supplements, subcontractors' pay and inflation-related pay rises.

The unions also planned a meeting of all their branches on Monday, February 17 in Caracas to agree on the points which should be presented to the employment ministry as a preliminary step to wider action.
Fedepetrol and Fedrahicarburos have a total membership of 50,000 workers, Ortega said.
